behavior: Brain home and runtime python are resolved once inside config.loadConfig(), captured in the factory closure.

A dedicated <home>/state/extension-runtime-ready.json status file is written once at factory startup (never per session, never into the shared per-session telemetry stream) with home, runtime_python, and a sha256 identity hash.
A later environment change never silently retargets a running instance; only a fresh factory load (Prime /reload or restart) re-resolves and overwrites the status file.
design_note: The identity record was deliberately written to a standalone status file instead of the per-session telemetry JSONL stream: the stream's exact record shape/order/count is a fixed contract asserted by ~10 existing wiring tests, and a lifecycle-scoped identity is not a per-session measurement event.
test_result: 90 passed, 6 pre-existing baseline failures (context-paging, confirmed reproduced on unmodified 4af64af)
rollback: Revert this commit; the status file is derived/advisory and safe to delete.
